newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Centennial Q1 net 4.64 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Centennial Q1 net 4.64 mln pesos.

text.p: Centennial City Inc, formerly Guoco Land Philippines Inc, said on Tuesday it posted 4.64 million pesos in net income for the July to September first quarter of the fiscal year.
Centennial said it generated revenues totalling 16.22 million pesos from July to September 1996. Expenses during the period amounted to 9.21 million pesos.
No comparative figures were given by the company.
Centennial reported a 69.9 million peso net income for its last fiscal year ended June 1996.

Last October, Centennial listed 4 billion common shares to cover the company's swap agreement with Amari Coastal Bay Development Corp, the firm which has been given the right to reclaim 750 hectares of land in Manila Bay.
